description: This PHP class defines an AWS SDK client for the Amazon Pinpoint SMS Voice V2 service, including method signatures for various API operations related to SMS and voice messaging.

classes.name: PinpointSMSVoiceV2Client
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the Amazon Pinpoint SMS Voice V2 service, providing methods for various SMS and voice operations.

methods.name: associateOriginationIdentity
methods.description: Associates an origination identity with the service, enabling it to send SMS or voice messages.

methods.name: createConfigurationSet
methods.description: Creates a new configuration set for managing SMS and voice message settings.

methods.name: sendTextMessage
methods.description: Sends a text message using the specified configuration and destination.

methods.name: deleteAccountDefaultProtectConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes the default protect configuration for the account.

methods.name: getResourcePolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the resource policy associated with the client.
